title: Emerging Markets Transition Factbook | BloombergNEF
gist: BNEF's Factbook says emerging markets drew a record $176 billion of new-build renewable investment in 2025 (25% of the global total), but flows are concentrated and grids, manufacturing and heavy industry lag. Distributed solar and EV sales are the fastest-moving segments.

insights.claim: Emerging markets and developing economies attracted a record $176 billion of new-build renewable investment in 2025, a decade-high 25% of the global total.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Capital is shifting toward emerging markets as a growing share of clean-energy flows.
insights.quote: Emerging markets attracted a record $176 billion of new-build renewable investment in 2025
insights.locator: Renewable investment reached a new high

insights.claim: Asia Pacific took almost half of EMDE renewable investment and nearly 90% of the net increase since 2023, with a small group of markets dominating flows.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Exposure to EMDE clean energy is effectively a bet on a few Asian markets.
insights.locator: Renewable investment reached a new high

insights.claim: Small-scale solar additions accelerated sharply across emerging markets in 2025, led by India at 16.9GW, Pakistan at 13.2GW and Brazil at 12.7GW.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Rooftop and distributed solar is a major demand channel for module suppliers outside utility-scale.
insights.locator: Distributed solar is opening new routes

insights.claim: Falling equipment costs, high grid tariffs and unreliable supply drive distributed solar deployment even where utility-scale pipelines remain limited.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Adoption is driven by consumer economics and weak grids, not policy, which makes it more durable.
insights.locator: Distributed solar is opening new routes

insights.claim: Low-carbon technologies made up 45% of installed capacity across emerging markets in 2025, up from around 32% in 2016.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Clean capacity share has risen about 13 points in nine years.

insights.claim: In several emerging markets low-carbon investment is running ahead of grid spending, raising the risk of connection delays, congestion and curtailment.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Grid and storage become the bottleneck and a beneficiary segment for investment.

insights.claim: Cleaner industrial projects, such as lower-emissions steel, remain small relative to planned coal-based capacity in emerging markets, while the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism pressures exporters to reduce and verify embedded emissions.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: CBAM is an external lever pulling exporters toward decarbonization faster than domestic economics.

insights.claim: Passenger EV sales in emerging markets jumped 67% in 2025 and are expected to reach 18% of global EV sales by 2035.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: EV growth is broadening beyond China, Europe and the US.

insights.claim: Emerging markets remain a small part of global clean-technology manufacturing, with India and Southeast Asia leading solar manufacturing and localization strategies producing mixed results.
insights.speaker: BloombergNEF (free content)
insights.so_what: Trade barriers and local-content rules shape factory siting, favoring a few hubs.
insights.locator: EMDEs remain a small part of global clean-technology manufacturing
